'''Lorne Turvey''' was a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and part-time operator of the small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Maz-Verlin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. He also requested [[Holodrama/Legends|holofeatures]] from [[Mair Koda]] on her trading runs.<ref name="TD" />
